releases.title: What's new in Penpot

highlights.title: Text v3 Per-Range Styles
highlights.description: Rich inline text styling with per-range fonts, sizes, weights, colors, and decorations using the new content tree model.

highlights.title: Main Menu Bar
highlights.description: Full File/Edit/View menu bar with keyboard mnemonics, hover-to-switch, and toggle items for rulers, grid, and snap.

highlights.title: System Clipboard
highlights.description: Copy, paste, and cut shapes directly to and from the system clipboard with full SVG and image support.

highlights.title: Multi-Select Bounding Box
highlights.description: Group bounding box with resize and rotation handles for multiple selected shapes.

highlights.title: Custom Canvas Scrollbars
highlights.description: Interactive scrollbars with drag-to-pan that appear when content extends beyond the viewport.

highlights.title: Fix Deleted Fonts
highlights.description: Automatic detection and repair of text shapes referencing fonts no longer in the team library.

features: Accessibility: ARIA roles, focus traps, and axe-core audit across 13 components
Database migration parity with 6 new SQLite migrations (0010-0015)
Wire-compatibility test suite with 34 + 112 transit roundtrip tests
Ruler guides with creation, snap, and persistence
SVG-to-shapes builder fully ported from upstream
Nested drag-drop in layer panel with reparenting
File thumbnails in dashboard with client-side generation
Node.js exporter service for PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, and PDF
fixes: Fixed boolean operations for concave shapes
Fixed isPointInGeomDataQ crash on line-only content
Fixed plugin API LibraryTypography.remove() UUID assertion error
Fixed MCP SSE sessions leaking memory on zombie connections
Fixed missing translation keys and i18n issues
